temporal.maturity: completed exits converted to America/New_York dates and cut off at each local window end
temporal.matching: same supplied month/local-slot stratum, exclude target mechanism; regime slices also fix regime
temporal.nonoverlap: preselect trigger indices before inspecting results; next i strictly > previous i + 6 + 1

sequential.selection: positive training nonoverlap net mean and supported matched increment; highest increment; mechanism id tie
sequential.training_zero_or_no_support: no eligible choice, no test events
sequential.test_maturity: exit local date no later than its own fold end; later exits censored
sequential.cross_fold_nonoverlap: i > last selected i + 6 + 1; last never resets on mechanism changes or missing choices
sequential.interpretation: prior-only event selection within repeatedly seen development data; not an account or independent validation

limitations: Overlapping windows are not independent repetitions.
Same-regime differences describe associations, not causal regime or decay attribution.
Signal selection and repeated development use do not restore independent validation.
Event selection is not an executable continuous account and cannot establish account frequency or goals.
